plan: E39 Amendment 3, reports/plans/2026-10-27_plan_broad-fragility.md -> 'Amendment 3 (2026-10-29)'. Filed before any run; never edited after. P1-P14 are E39's, A1's and A2's; this file holds P15-P17.

definitions.check: the check ratio: Pile harness PGD KL (one random start, adversary seed 0, 20 steps of 0.1, 256 val rows) over W0's at seed 0 in the same job; fixed lines: pass <= 1.4, fail >= 1.61
definitions.s: behaviour kept, (logp - logp_W0) / (logp_teacher - logp_W0), mean next-token log-probability on 64 held-out lowercase rows; the teacher is the fine-tune the state was trained from (Adam for tests 1-2)
definitions.share of excess removed: (r_trained - r_revert) / (r_trained - 1), r the check ratio, r_trained this job's
definitions.stable rank: ||dW||_F^2 / ||dW||_2^2 per matrix, mean over the 24 matrices
definitions.random move: per matrix, Gaussian noise on the alive U and V, each side's noise rescaled to that side's Frobenius norm, one scale per matrix solved so ||U'V'^T - UV^T|| = the multiple times the trained state's ||delta-W|| (so the relative change matches); Delta fixed
definitions.rate rule: per arm, among grid rates that did not diverge (a non-finite training loss or a held-out gain not above 0) the one whose held-out gain is nearest the Adam fine-tune's in this job; none: that arm's P5-P7 are not scored
definitions.verdict: pass if check <= 1.4, fail if >= 1.61, between otherwise (both lines inclusive); a non-finite check leaves its prediction unscored
definitions.damage: KL(W0 || state), mean over every position of 64 held-out plain Pile val rows (E37's)
definitions.gain: held-out mean next-token log-probability on 64 lowercase rows, state minus W0
definitions.component training with labels: component_training.train from W0's alive (U, V), Gamma and Delta frozen, loss next-token cross-entropy on E37's 2,400 lowercase rows (8 rows a step, drawn with replacement in batch order 0); Adam at [1e-05, 3e-05], plain SGD at [0.01, 0.03, 0.1], states at steps [100, 300, 1000]; per optimiser the state not diverged whose gain is nearest the Adam fine-tune's (ties: earlier rate, then step)
definitions.SGD held to rank 8: E39's plain SGD fine-tune (300 steps of 8 rows, each row once) with every matrix's W - W0 replaced by its best rank-8 approximation after every step (rank_cap.truncate); rates [0.01, 0.03, 0.1], E39's rate rule
definitions.share beyond rank 8: per matrix the share of ||dW||_F^2 beyond the top 8 singular values; pooled = sum of tails over sum of norms over the 24 matrices
definitions.second seed: the rank-8 LoRA at rate 1e-4 with LoRA seed 1 (the read factor's initialisation) and teacher training at batch order 1, both changed together
definitions.second rows: Pile val rows 256-511 (A2's), the check's harness (two blocks of 128, one adversary per block, seed 0), W0 read on them as the reference
definitions.matched random move: E39's random move (fragility.random_move: Gaussian noise on the alive U and V, each side at its own Frobenius norm, per matrix scaled to x times the trained state's ||delta-W||), x found by search (double from 4, then bisect in log x, at most 12 reads) until damage is within 5% of the trained decomposition's in this job; Delta fixed; noise seeds 0 and 1
definitions.SGD teacher-trained decompositions: teacher training (E37's recipe) on A1's plain SGD fine-tune (rate 0.01) and on A2's SGD held to rank 8 (rate 0.03), both regenerated in the job (A1/A2 read them 2.067 and 2.122 on the first rows)
definitions.labelled SGD state at step 1,000: A2's component training with labels, plain SGD at 0.03 (the rate of A2's passing state), batch order 0, its state at step 1000
definitions.SGD LoRA: E39's rank-8 LoRA on all 24 matrices (B = 0, A ~ N(0, 1/d_in), LoRA seed 0, 300 steps of 8 lowercase rows each once, clip 1.0) trained by plain SGD (momentum 0, no weight decay) at the rate of [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0] (E27's grid 0.003-3, its top five rates) chosen by E39's rule: among rates not diverged (a non-finite training loss or a held-out gain not above 0), the gain nearest this job's Adam fine-tune's

controls.stage0_i: first, alone: W0's PGD spread over seeds 0-2 <= 0.1 and seed 0's PGD KL per block within 1% of (0.6794, 0.7182); else stop
controls.stage0_ii: E37's Adam fine-tune regenerated: held-out gain within 0.005 of 0.1301; E37's teacher training retrained in-job (amend1's arm 1 to step 1000) and read: check within 3% of 2.2011 and s within 0.01 of 0.998; else stop
controls.G_rows2: first on the second rows: W0's spread over adversary seeds 0-2 <= 0.1 and the Adam teacher-trained decomposition's check >= 1.61 and within 3% of A2's 1.8826; else stop
controls.regenerated SGD fine-tunes: held-out gains within 0.005 of 0.13671 (plain) and 0.13142 (rank 8); else stop
controls.G_first: each regenerated SGD teacher-trained decomposition read on the first rows: check within 3% of A1/A2's [2.0675, 2.1218] (plain, rank 8); else P15 is unscored and the stop rule does not apply
controls.G_label: the labelled SGD state at step 100 has gain within 0.005 of A2's 0.12534; else P16 is unscored
controls.lora_ref: before the SGD LoRA, E39's Adam LoRA regenerated: gain within 0.005 of 0.1479, its teacher-trained check within 3% of 1.2726 and <= 1.4; else stop
controls.G_nothing: the SGD LoRA's do-nothing check >= 1.61 (the positive control: the check fails the update left in Delta, as the Adam LoRA's 2.653 did); else P17 is unscored

stop_rule: after the second rows are read: if both SGD teacher-trained checks are <= 1.4 (and G_rows2 and G_first held), the job stops before the label and lora_sgd stages

rows2.fail: Both SGD teacher-trained decompositions fail on the second rows too: their fail is not one block of 128 rows, and the contrast with the LoRA's teacher-trained decompositions (which pass there) stands.
rows2.mixed: On the second rows one SGD teacher-trained decomposition fails and the other does not, or one lands between the lines: the SGD fail holds on new rows only in part, and the contrast with the LoRA is weaker than on the first rows.
rows2.pass: Both SGD teacher-trained decompositions pass on the second rows: their fail rests on one block of 128 rows, little is left for the SGD LoRA to separate, and the job stops before training it (the plan's stop rule).
rows2.unscored: The second rows' control failed (the job stopped), the regenerated SGD decompositions did not reproduce their first-rows checks (G_first), or a check was not finite: unanswered.

label.fail: Component training with labels and plain SGD fails the check at step 1,000 where it passed at step 100: E21/E26's narrow-task pattern (SGD passes early, fails late) holds on the broad task, and A2's labelled pass is only an early state.
label.pass: Component training with labels and plain SGD still passes at step 1,000: on this task SGD's labelled pass is not only an early state, unlike E21/E26 on narrow tasks.
label.between: The labelled SGD state at step 1,000 lands between the lines: not separated.
label.unscored: The step-100 state did not reproduce A2's, the run diverged, or its gain is over 30% from the Adam fine-tune's: unanswered.
